Nate (Partnerships): Heads-up: partners requested a combined Gaudi+MI300 marketplace sync. Goal: coordinated marketplace listing + SI playbook before EOM. Quick run-through?
Olga (Eng-ML): agree. main risk: MI300 driver 6.1.0 has new smem allocator change that affects batch packing. We saw ~3% perf regression on long-context evals. Need quantized fallback profile for those flows.
Priya (SI): SI teams need a clear mapping: which workloads to prefer Gaudi vs MI300, plus recommended docker images. Can we publish a single-table decision matrix?
Tom (Cloud Marketplace): Each cloud needs separate SKU IDs and billing metadata. AWS wants AMI tag + sku_code, Azure wants armTemplate snippet. I'll draft marketplace metadata template.
Arjun (AMD): AMD is tracking the MI300 driver fix (6.1.1) - target EOD Thu for signed package. We'll push a hotfix repo and notify SI channels.
Nate (Partnerships): embargo? partners want a soft embargo from Fri 05:00 PT -> Mon 12:00 PT to avoid weekend surprises. Thoughts?
Olga (Eng-ML): prefer weekday push. If driver arrives Fri EOD, we need at least 24h lab soak. Suggest embargo Mon 06:00-12:00 PT with canary earlier Mon 00:00-04:00 PT.
Priya (SI): SI checklist draft: 1) verify driver version (6.1.1+), 2) verify docker base `redwood/rlib:gaudi-mi300-2026-03`, 3) validate quantize profile `q8_4_mix`, 4) run sample benchmark `./bench.sh --ctx 8192 --batch 4`. I'll publish to SI Confluence page.
Tom (Cloud Marketplace): sample marketplace metadata (we'll fill cloud-specific ids):
```
name: "Redwood Gaudi + MI300 Optimized"
clouds:
  - aws:
      ami_tag: gaudi-mi300-2026-03
      sku: TBD
  - azure:
      template: gaudi-mi300-arm.json
  - gcp:
      image: gaudi-mi300-2026-03
compat: ["gaudi-v2", "mi300-1"]
```
release-bot: Preflight checks scheduled: preflight-4322501111 -> start=2026-03-15T08:00:00Z, checks=[driver,smoke,perf], report=https://release.redwood/internal/preflight/4322501111
Arjun (AMD): We'll attach signed driver artifact to that preflight. ETA 2026-03-15T02:00:00Z.
Olga (Eng-ML): Canary routing idea: traffic split by workload tag instead of region. Route `short-context` to Gaudi by default, `long-context` to MI300; 5% of `long-context` traffic to fallback quantized MI300 on high mem pressure. Policy snippet:
```
policy:
  by_workload:
    long-context:
      primary: mi300-full
      fallback: mi300-q8_4
      rollout: 5%
```
Priya (SI): we'll need kernel tuning notes too (hugepage settings + oom_score_adj). I'll put a minimal script: `sysctl -w vm.nr_hugepages=128`.
Nate (Partnerships): OK action items: 1) Arjun to deliver signed driver (ETA Thu EOD); 2) Olga to prepare quantized profile and perf targets; 3) Tom to draft cloud metadata templates; 4) Priya to publish SI checklist + scripts; 5) Runbook call Tue 09:00 PT.
Tom (Cloud Marketplace): I'll add per-cloud templating and a small press embargo clause placeholder.
Arjun (AMD): noted, will ping Priya once artifact uploaded.
Olga (Eng-ML): will post perf numbers to the preflight report once bench runs finish.
release-bot: Preflight report updated: preflight-4322501111 -> status=running
Priya (SI): also tagging SI integrators: they'll need a 2-hour office hours window during the canary.
Nate (Partnerships): Great. Let's keep updates here only. If anything slips, we'll move the embargo. Thanks all.
